description:
Our Club was Platinum Co-host Club for Udaan – 22nd Interact District Conference to be held on Friday, 9th October 2026 from 8.15 am to 1 pm at Deenanath Mangeshkar Hall, Vile Parle (East).
Our Participating Schools: Rotary Sanskardham School and Auxilium Convent High School
Rotary Sanskardham School: 12 students participated in the Folk Dance Competition.
Auxilium Convent High School: 7 students participated in Art and Project Presentation (PowerPoint) competitions.
Achievement: One prize in Art Competition — Judge’s Choice Award!
The conference provided students with a wonderful opportunity to showcase their talents and creativity.
Attended by 19 students and 2 teachers.
Project cost Rs 2,850/-
